text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children over their parents, mentioning that among a child’s rights are that their name be chosen well and that they receive good tarbiyah (upbringing). It also highlights the importance of teaching and disciplining the child with rifq (gentleness) and wisdom, while avoiding harshness and neglect.
